content.rendered:
Crow Canyon Country Club DJ

Beautiful Day, Ceremony and Reception at the Crow Canyon Country Golf Club.

Chaudoin/ Harrison Wedding Itinerary for 5/10/14

5PM Guests will arrive

5:30PM Wedding Ceremony will Start
Attendants and Bridesmaids: Bittersweet Symphony by Vitamin String Quartet

Bride Entrance Song: A Thousand Years by the Piano Guys (Piano/Cello Cover)

Bride and Groom Exit Song: Let Me Hold you by Josh Krajcik

6PM Cocktail Reception/ Bridal Party and wedding photos

7PM Introductions

1. Mr and Mrs Dick and Rebecca Chaudoin
2. Mr and Mrs Tom and Ann Harrison
3. Tanner Clifton: Usher
4. Kailee Clifton : Flower Girl
5. Collyn: Ring Bearer
6. Elizabeth Barnes and Dan Taber
7. Jessica Barnes and Jon Marotta
8. Nicole Marino and Vinny Kinne
9. Samantha Harris and Chad Harrison (Maid of Honor and Best Man)
10. Mr and Mrs Greg and Amy Harrison

Dinner/ Toasts

Who will be making the toast and cake cutting: Father of the bride, possibly father of the groom, maid of honor, best man, groom and bride
7:15-8:15PM First Dance, Father Daughter dance, Mother Son Dance, Parents Dance and open dance

Bride and Groom first dance: Over the Rainbow by Israel Kamakawiwaole

Father/Daughter: I Loved Her First by Heartland

Mother/Son: Landslide by Fleetwood Mac

Bride and Grooms Parents: The Road that Never Ends by Keali’i

Reichel start things off and then have all couples join (please announce both parents anniversaries as they are both in May)

Crow Canyon Country Club Wedding  DJ MC & Photo Booth.
